name: Chosen of the Moon cuts Physical damage taken by 60% (#1097)
contract: Chosen of the Moon 680755 (Spell.dbc, SpellFamilyName 32 (Starcaller). instant, no cost, self target, RecoveryTime 180000, DurationIndex 1 = 10 s. Effect 0 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN (87), EffectMiscValue 1 (Physical), EffectBasePoints -61 with DieSides 1 resolves to -60. This matches the tooltip 'reducing all Physical damage taken by $s1%'. Native path: Unit::MeleeDamageBonusTaken multiplies by GetTotalAuraMultiplierByMiscMask(SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN, schoolMask), read by the melee_damage_taken metric with a fixed base of 1000 and a creature as attacker, so a white hit of 1000 must become 400. The same actor is measured before and after the cast. Effect 1 triggers the taunt helper 680756 and Effect 2 is an Umbral Blade chance modifier; neither is asserted, and the helper's 6 s duration against the 10 s tooltip is a data conflict recorded elsewhere, not judged here. Cast the spell once, it has a 180 s cooldown.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Physical damage taken from a 1000 white hit before the cast
Cast Chosen of the Moon on self
Chosen of the Moon is applied
A 1000 Physical hit is reduced to 40%
